title: JCO (Religious Teacher), Soldier (GD), Soldier (Clerk SD) and Soldier Tradesmen
age_limit: JCO: Up to 55 Years of Service; Other Ranks: Up to 50 Years of Service

title: Nayab Tehsildar, Excise Inspector, Supply Inspector, Marketing Inspector, Labour Enforcement Officer, Tax Officer, Zila Panchayat, Senior Cane Development Inspector, Cane Development Inspector
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Agriculture from a recognized university. Preference given to post-graduate degree holders in Agricultural Science, other things being equal in direct recruitment.
salary: All posts are Group C, non-gazetted, and covered under the contributory pension scheme (अंशदायी पेंशनयुक्त).
age_limit: Minimum Age:21 years || Maximum Age:42 years || Birth Date Range:Candidates must not have been born before 02 July 1984 and not after 01 July 2005.
application_fee: Rs. 166.36 for UR/OBC/EWS, Rs. 76.36 for SC/ST/PwD, and No Fee for orphan children residing in state/voluntary homes in Uttarakhand
selection_process: The selection process comprises three consecutive stages: || Preliminary Examination:Objective-type screening test consisting of General Studies and General Aptitude Test. || Main Examination:Written descriptive-type examination comprising four papers. || Personality Test (Interview):Viva-voce test for candidates provisionally successful in the main written examination.

title: Technician Grade II
qualification: High School or equivalent examination from a recognized Board with Science and Mathematics, All India/State Vocational Certificate in Electrician trade, and 2 years of relevant work experience obtained after acquiring the required qualification
salary: All three Technician Grade II categories carry the same notified Level-4 pay scale.
age_limit: Candidates should have completed 18 years of age and should not have completed 42 years as on 01 July 2026. || The notification provides age relaxation according to Uttarakhand Government rules for eligible reserved categories. It mentions relaxation provisions for eligible SC, ST and OBC candidates, Persons with Disabilities, dependants of freedom fighters and eligible ex-servicemen, subject to the conditions prescribed in the notification.
application_fee: The examination fee can be paid through the online payment options provided in the application system, including Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or UPI, as available on the portal.
